defects.description: Glossary requires the term "disk quota" to be rendered as "дисковая квота"; the heading uses "Диск Квоты" which does not match the required term.
The term "disk quota" is incorrectly translated as "Диск-квоты" instead of the required "дисковая квота".
The term "disk quota" is incorrectly translated as "диск-квоты" instead of the required "дисковая квота".
The phrase "квоты на диск" does not use the required glossary term "дисковая квота".
Glossary term "quota support" should be rendered as "поддержка квот"; the translation uses "поддержку для квот на диске".
Glossary term "kernel configuration" should be rendered as "конфигурация ядра"; the translation uses "файл конфигурации ядра".
The phrase "квоты дисков" does not follow the required term "дисковая квота".
